answer_1.quote: In this work, we evaluated the ability of GPT models to generate dialogue summaries that adhere to human guidelines

answer_2.quote: Evaluating three GPT models against task-specific pre-trained models on English and French datasets with distinct communication goals (DialogSum and DECODA); • Assessing performance using automatic metrics (ROUGE, BERTScore, and LLM-as-judge)

answer_4.quote: Due to the misalignment between automatic measures and human judgment of LLM outputs, as evidenced in news summarization experiments with GPT-3 , we set up a human evaluation.
answer_4.guideline: The evaluation interface, shown in Figure , features a dialogue at the top, accompanied by six different summaries, including references and model outputs from BARThez, 3.5-WL, 3.5-HGR→WL, 4-WL, and 4-HGR→WL... Annotators assessed each summary based on four criteria...
